articles.titleOriginal: Visionary Pathway: The Enduring Voice of Minju Opera
articles.summaryJa: 4世紀以上にわたり、民謡は福州の文化的アイデンティティの一部となってきました。しかし、1980年代には、芸術形態は生き残りをかけた戦いに直面しました。1990年から1996年まで福州市書記長を務めた習近平氏は、劇団のための安定した資金調達から専用の訓練学校の設立まで、福州市を維持するための一連の措置を提唱した。
articles.summaryOriginal: For more than four centuries, Minju Opera has been part of Fuzhou's cultural identity. But in the 1980s, the art form faced a fight for survival. Xi Jinping, who served as Party secretary of Fuzhou from 1990 to 1996, championed a series of measures to preserve it — from securing stable funding for theater troupes to establishing a dedicated training school. Today, thanks to decades of sustained efforts, the ancient art form has found new life and continues to inspire new generations.

articles.summaryOriginal: The torch, medals, promotional songs and official uniforms for the Changchun 2027 Winter Universiade were unveiled on Wednesday, which marked the 100-day countdown to the games. The games, featuring 97 events of 12 sports, will be held from Jan 15 to 25, 2027, in Changchun and Jilin cities of Jilin province.

articles.titleOriginal: Samsung Electronics 1st Korean firm to top W100 tril. in quarterly operating profit
articles.titleJa: サムスン電子、韓国初のW 100 trilの四半期営業利益を達成
articles.summaryJa: サムスン電子は、木曜日に第3四半期の営業利益が107.4兆ウォンと推定し、四半期の営業利益が100兆ウォンを超える最初の韓国企業になりました。同社はまた、195兆ウォンの収益を見積もっています。
articles.summaryOriginal: Samsung Electronics estimated 107.4 trillion won in third-quarter operating profit on Thursday, becoming the first Korean company to surpass 100 trillion won in quarterly operating profit. The company also estimated 195 trillion won in revenue. If finalized later this month, operating profit would rise 782.5 percent year-on-year and sales 126.6 percent. Memory chips, including HBM4 and DRAM, were widely seen as the main drivers. A traffic light is seen at Samsung Electronics headquarters in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, July 30. Yonhap

articles.titleOriginal: Interview Digital assets gain ground, but risk assessment remains key: Moody's Ratings
articles.titleJa: インタビューデジタル資産は増加していますが、リスク評価は依然として重要です：ムーディーズ・レーティングス
articles.summaryJa: Moody's RatingsのエグゼクティブディレクターであるGene Fang氏は、デジタル資産が従来の金融に統合されるにつれて、投資家は比較可能なリスク評価をますます必要とするだろうと述べた。
articles.summaryOriginal: Gene Fang, executive director at Moody’s Ratings, said investors will increasingly need comparable risk assessments as digital assets become integrated into traditional finance. Moody’s has rated more than 45 digital issuances globally worth over $6.9 billion since January 2018, including about four digital bonds issued by Korean companies this year. The agency applies conventional credit analysis while adding assessments of blockchain, smart-contract, asset-representation, regulatory and cybersecurity risks. Fang said Korea’s strong institutions could help it capture digital-asset benefits if policymakers establish a comprehensive framework. An illustration of Bitcoin / Korea Times photo by Shim Hyun-chul
